about: Charlottetown is the capital of Prince Edward Island, on a sheltered harbour where the Hillsborough, North, and West (Elliott) rivers meet. It is the province’s government, university, and cultural centre, and the hall where the 1864 Charlottetown Conference met still stands. A compact brick downtown, a working waterfront, and Victorian neighbourhoods sit within walking distance of the harbour. About 39,000 people live in Charlottetown.
seoSummary: Prince Edward Island’s capital on a three-river harbour, the meeting place of the Charlottetown Conference.
